correction.mechanism: every python_callable evaluation runs the harness with -I -B -X pycache_prefix=<fresh empty directory of the evaluation's own>: the interpreter reads and writes cached bytecode only under that prefix, so in-tree __pycache__ (committed by a developer or left by anything) is never the subject and the checkout is never written; the prefix lies under the story's controller-owned scratch when the probe was given one (disposed with that StoryScope resource) else under a temporary directory of the probe's own; it is never reused across evaluations, parties, criteria, revisions or attempts, and an evaluation directory inside the checkout is refused
correction.primary_control: external fresh pycache prefix (-X pycache_prefix, command line — survives -I/-E)
correction.defence_in_depth: -B (no bytecode written), also on the developer-test runners (-E -s -B; -B -m pytest)
